title: Fixed Curled Deck Chain And Paired Link Sides
description: One wholly newly authored fixed curled-deck bridge-style architectural apparatus. A grounded bank foot and short fixed approach carry paired root pivot pedestals. Eight complete thick deck sections form one upward and returning open polygonal curl, linked by whole transverse headed pin appearances rather than a single rigid bridge leaf. Two full side assemblies follow that chain: independent complete posts at the shared deck axes meet separate upper links and proud joint barrels, leaving real open panels and a large open centre. The deck sections have bounded end gaps around the retained pins; no painted articulation or hidden curved support sheet. Unlike the rolling-heel bridge, there are no curved sector shoes, rigid long truss span or counterweight; unlike the sectional overhead door, there are no curved C guides, rollers or wall jambs. All shapes newly authored, not old panels or bridge pieces extracted. Three opaque untextured PBR roles, metres Z up and full horizontal envelope centred at ground, one whole model zero scenes. Permanent stylized display only, without a river, roadway or person. No solved folding motion, real hinge contact, linked-bar kinematics, actuator, load capacity, usable crossing, navigation, engineering, fabrication or safety performance. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
